analysis: The only changed file is CHANGELOG.md (documentation). The patch renames the v0.9.20 heading from "candidate (unpublished)" to "v0.9.20 - 2026-10-12", adds a v0.9.21 candidate section (prepared 2026-10-13) with one Fixed entry, and rewrites the 0.9.20 bullet about unreleased entries. The v0.9.21 entry says one-token startup health-check timings are excluded from serving throughput estimates, and that supported loaded models (dense and MoE Qwens) are bootstrapped with bounded, preemptible measurements. No code, configuration, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or data-exposure paths change. The throughput-estimate behavior is described only in prose; the implementing code is not in this batch. Routing and performance measurement changes could touch coordinator provider selection and provider-reported rates, but their effect cannot be assessed here. Threat IDs mentioned in the canonical context (T-041 and others) are unaffected by this diff. No threat-model assumptions are invalidated by the text, so no findings. Coverage limit: the implementation of the described measurement bootstrap is not supplied, so later passes should examine it if it appears in other units, in particular whether provider-reported or bootstrapped throughput can be manipulated to bias routing or earnings (ADV-001).
